  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED','EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS violation_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_instruction_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED','EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio

JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id

JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ph.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot ph ON wp.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ph.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

    g.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
    p.display_name AS party_name,
    g.guarantee_count,
    b.borrower_count
FROM (
    SELECT guarantor_party_id, COUNT(*) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
) g

    SELECT borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS borrower_count
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
) b ON g.guarantor_party_id = b.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY g.guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       ptc.name_zh,
       pe.amount,
       ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
       p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
       ind_org.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
       ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
       ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_org ON op.industry_code = ind_org.sector_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    p.business_date AS 业务日期,
    p.amount AS 金额,
    payer.party_id AS 付款方客户编号,
    payee.party_id AS 收款方客户编号
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account_holder payer 
    ON p.from_account_id = payer.account_id AND payer.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder payee 
    ON p.to_account_id = payee.account_id AND payee.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (
        (pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id)
        OR (pr.source_party_id = payee.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer.party_id)
    )
WHERE p.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event p
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    c.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    c.event_date,
    c.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(c.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 c
JOIN institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.completion_date IS NULL OR c.completion_date = ''
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT s.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       c.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
       c.status AS 抵押物状态,
       s.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM security_agreement s
JOIN collateral_link cl ON s.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset c ON cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
WHERE c.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY s.security_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
       sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT i.institution_name,
         ld.loan_id,
         lbs.principal_balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY i.institution_id
           ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM loan_drawdown ld
  JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
  JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
  JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT institution_name,
       loan_id,
       ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_industry AS (
    SELECT
        ls.loan_id,
        ls.principal_balance,
        ins.sector_name_zh AS industry_name
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN industry_sector ins ON ins.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_name ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_industry
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY industry_name ASC, rn ASC;

SELECT
  business_date,
  COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
  COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH loan_info AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id, ca.institution_id, lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
avg_balance AS (
    SELECT institution_id, ROUND(AVG(principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_info
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name, li.loan_id, li.principal_balance, ab.avg_balance, ROUND(li.principal_balance - ab.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_info li
JOIN avg_balance ab ON li.institution_id = ab.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON li.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE li.principal_balance > ab.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT s.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       s.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 担保人数量
FROM security_agreement s
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON s.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE s.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collateral_link cl WHERE cl.security_id = s.security_id)
GROUP BY s.security_id, s.secured_amount
ORDER BY s.secured_amount DESC;

       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额

GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC

    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 经办笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY sm.home_org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 经办笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(*) AS 客户数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS 平均年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS 高收入客户占比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT
    p.payment_id,
    p.amount,
    COALESCE(fa.institution_id, ta.institution_id) AS institution_id,
    fh.party_id AS from_party_id,
    th.party_id AS to_party_id
  FROM payment_event p
  LEFT JOIN account fa ON fa.account_id = p.from_account_id
  LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.account_id = p.to_account_id
  LEFT JOIN account_holder fh ON fh.account_id = p.from_account_id AND fh.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  LEFT JOIN account_holder th ON th.account_id = p.to_account_id AND th.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
),
rel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id, target_party_id
  FROM party_relation
  WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
)
SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rel.source_party_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rel.source_party_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(t.amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM txn t
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = t.institution_id
LEFT JOIN rel ON rel.source_party_id = t.from_party_id AND rel.target_party_id = t.to_party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    cc.card_count AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    td.deposit_count AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM (
    SELECT pc.holder_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    INNER JOIN party pt ON pc.holder_party_id = pt.party_id AND pt.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
) cc
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ah.party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
    FROM term_deposit td
    INNER JOIN account_holder ah ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
    INNER JOIN party pt ON ah.party_id = pt.party_id AND pt.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    GROUP BY ah.party_id
) td ON cc.party_id = td.party_id
INNER JOIN party p ON cc.party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY td.deposit_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
  FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
  WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  loan_id,
  ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
  quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(i.sector_name_zh, '未知行业') AS industry_name,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector i ON i.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY COALESCE(i.sector_name_zh, '未知行业')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        ROUND(SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1.0
              / SUM(total_balance) OVER (), 6) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM industry_balance
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld

GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    cv.valuation_amount AS 最新评估价值

ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,

GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
