我们根据题目要求，统计各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数与这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计。需要输出机构名称、集团成员户数、余额合计，按余额合计降序。

理解：机构是institution，客户是party，敞口集团成员在exposure_group_member中。贷款本金余额在loan_balance_snapshot中，关联loan_drawdown，再关联credit_agreement得到机构。但注意：题目说“各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”，这里的机构应该是客户归属的机构？还是贷款发放的机构？通常银行统计客户属于集团成员的户数，可能按客户归属机构（party.home_org_unit_id对应的机构？）但更合理的是按贷款所在机构？题目说“这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”，本行指该机构，所以应该是按贷款所属机构统计。但“各机构客户”可能指该机构的客户，即客户归属机构？需要仔细分析。

通常监管统计中，集团客户成员户数按客户归属机构统计，贷款余额按贷款发放机构统计。但题目要求“各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”和“这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”，可能是指对于每个机构，统计该机构下的客户（即客户归属机构）中属于集团成员的户数，以及这些成员在该机构（本行）的贷款余额。但贷款余额可能涉及多个机构？一个客户可能在不同机构有贷款，但这里“本行”指该机构，所以应该按贷款所属机构过滤。

另一种理解：按贷款所属机构统计，即每个机构发放的贷款中，借款人是集团成员的户数（去重）和贷款余额合计。但“客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”可能指该机构的客户（即客户归属机构）中属于集团成员的户数，然后这些成员的贷款余额（不管在哪个机构？但“本行”指该机构，所以应该是该机构作为贷款机构的余额）。

为了明确，我们看常见监管报表：统计集团客户在各机构的成员户数和贷款余额，通常按机构维度，机构是贷款发放机构，成员户数是指在该机构有贷款的集团成员客户数（去重），余额是该机构发放的贷款余额。但题目说“各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”，可能指该机构的客户（即客户归属机构）中属于集团成员的户数，但贷款余额可能在其他机构？不太合理。

我们再看表结构：party有home_org_unit_id归属机构单元，通过organization_unit可以关联到institution。所以客户归属机构可以确定。贷款余额在loan_balance_snapshot，通过loan_drawdown关联credit_agreement，credit_agreement有institution_id。所以贷款余额按贷款机构。

题目要求“各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”和“这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”，可能是指：对于每个机构，统计该机构下的客户（即归属该机构的客户）中属于集团成员的户数，以及这些成员在该机构（即该机构作为贷款机构）的贷款余额合计。但这样可能一个客户属于多个机构？客户归属机构只有一个，但贷款可能在不同机构。如果客户归属A机构，但在B机构有贷款，那么B机构统计时，该客户不是B机构的客户，但贷款在B，是否算？题目说“各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数”，明确是“机构客户”，即该机构的客户，所以应该按客户归属机构统计户数。然后“这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”，本行指该机构，所以贷款余额应该限定为该机构作为贷款机构的余额。但这样可能户数和余额不对应，因为客户归属A，贷款在B，那么A统计户数时包含该客户，但余额不包含（因为贷款不在A），B统计户数时不包含该客户（因为客户不归属B），但余额包含。这样会导致户数和余额不匹配。通常监管统计中，集团客户成员户数按客户归属机构统计，贷款余额按贷款机构统计，但两者可能不一致，但题目要求同时输出，可能期望按贷款机构统计户数（即在该机构有贷款的集团成员客户数）和余额。因为“这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”明确“本行”，所以应该是贷款机构。

再读题：“统计各机构客户中属于敞口集团成员的户数与这些成员在本行的贷款本金余额合计”，可以理解为：对于每个机构，统计该机构的客户（即该机构作为贷款机构的客户？）中属于集团成员的户数，以及这些成员在该机构的贷款余额。但“机构客户”通常指该机构服务的客户，可能通过贷款关系或账户关系。但更直接的是通过credit_agreement的institution_id，因为贷款协议属于某机构，借款人就是该机构的客户。所以我们可以按credit_agreement.institution_id分组，统计借款人是集团成员的客户数（去重）和贷款余额合计。

因此，我们采用：从loan_balance_snapshot取本金余额，关联loan_drawdown，再关联credit_agreement得到institution_id，再关联institution得到机构名称。同时，借款人party_id需要属于exposure_group_member。注意：loan_balance_snapshot有principal_balance，我们需要的是本金余额合计，可能取最新快照？题目没有明确，但审计基准日为2026-06-30，所以应该取as_of_date='2026-06-30'的快照。另外，贷款可能有多个借据，每个借据有余额，我们汇总所有借据的余额。户数需要去重借款人party_id。

所以SQL

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(gc.commitment_id) > 1 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) AS INTEGER) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount AS instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi
    ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee
    ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    ins.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector ins ON ca.target_industry_code = ins.sector_code
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND ins.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH loan_inst AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id,
           i.institution_name,
           lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
inst_avg AS (
    SELECT institution_name,
           AVG(principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_inst
    GROUP BY institution_name
)
SELECT li.institution_name,
       li.loan_id,
       ROUND(li.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(ia.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
       ROUND(li.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_inst li
JOIN inst_avg ia ON li.institution_name = ia.institution_name
WHERE li.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
    SELECT pr.source_party_id FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_related_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
    SELECT pr.source_party_id FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 执行年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 1.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT target_industry_code, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_rate * 1.10
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON ld.loan_id = llb.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
exceeding_customers AS (
    SELECT
        be.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exceeding_customer_count
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON be.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital > 0.10
    GROUP BY be.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ec.exceeding_customer_count
FROM exceeding_customers ec
JOIN institution i ON ec.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY ec.exceeding_customer_count DESC;

SELECT
  eg.exposure_group_id,
  eg.group_name,
  ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_balance,
  ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
  ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
  ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
 AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
  ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
  ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
 AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY days_interval ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_bal AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.party_id,
        ROUND(lb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM loan_bal lb
    JOIN cap c ON lb.institution_id = c.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON lb.party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        rc.institution_id,
        rc.party_id,
        rc.ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.institution_id ORDER BY rc.ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM ratio_calc rc
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    r.ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON r.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lb.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id), 2) AS pct
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, pct DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status AS status,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs
    ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, overdue_principal_total DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT loan_account_id, disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM party p
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
)
AND p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
)
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event p
    WHERE p.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND p.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS maturity_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket
  WHEN '常态' THEN 1
  WHEN '临期' THEN 2
  WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS related_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY related_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type AS collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH account_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        alc.loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON ld.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(*) AS account_count,
  ROUND(SUM(abs_diff), 2) AS total_diff
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.institution_id,
    a.account_id,
    (b.ledger_balance - b.available_balance) AS abs_diff
  FROM account a
  JOIN account_balance_snapshot b
    ON a.account_id = b.account_id
  WHERE b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND b.ledger_balance > b.available_balance
    AND (b.ledger_balance - b.available_balance) > 5000000
) t
JOIN institution i
  ON t.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_diff DESC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.opening_principal, t.maturity_on, t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
  ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
  ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
  ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
  ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
  ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_amount IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status <> 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS actual_raise_total,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS planned_raise_total,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status <> 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
    6
  ) AS completion_rate
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.institution i
  ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT
  p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
  p.display_name AS borrower_name,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.overdue_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS overdue_loan_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM repayment_schedule rs
      WHERE rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue_cnt
  FROM loan_drawdown ld
  JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
) t
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = t.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.overdue_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.overdue_cnt = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
  rs.loan_id,
  COUNT(*) AS unsettled_installment_count,
  ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT target_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
),
inst_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS contract_rate,
    ROUND(ia.avg_rate, 4) AS avg_rate,
    ROUND(ia.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN inst_avg ia
    ON ia.institution_id = ca.institution_id
   AND ia.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < ia.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id AS target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT
  eg.group_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
  ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
  ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
  ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
  ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
 AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
  ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb
  ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
 AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
  ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
 AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc
    ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN account_holder ah_from
    ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to
    ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party payer
    ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN party payee
    ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '转账'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payee.party_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot
WHERE investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  lb.loan_id,
  ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
  ROUND(MAX(d.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d
  ON d.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lb.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
  eg.exposure_group_id,
  eg.group_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
  ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
  eg.exposure_group_id,
  eg.group_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
  ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
  ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
  ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
 AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) - COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND g.guarantee_total > l.loan_total
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC

SELECT
  p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
  p.party_id AS 客户编号,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
  ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
  so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
  so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON ah.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
   AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
   AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, 借款人客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
  ou.org_unit_id,
  ou.unit_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY loan_id
HAVING SUM(principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
  ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(facility_total.limit_sum, 2) AS limit_sum,
    ROUND(drawdown_total.disbursed_sum, 2) AS disbursed_sum,
    ROUND(cap.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(drawdown_total.disbursed_sum * 1.0 / cap.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS limit_sum
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
) facility_total ON facility_total.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS disbursed_sum
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) drawdown_total ON drawdown_total.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cap
    ON cap.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND cap.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE drawdown_total.disbursed_sum > cap.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
  sa.security_id,
  ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
  COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
  ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
  ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
 AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT cf.facility_id,
       ROUND(cf.limit_amount, 2) AS limit_amount,
       sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc
  ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
 AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i
    ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式,
    COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH on_sale_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT
    quartile_group,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM on_sale_products
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY quartile_group
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_revolving_limit,
  COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT
  itc.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
  sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_officer_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_assignment sa
    ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_officer_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ROUND(ds.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg
    ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND p.required_amount > 0
  AND (p.recognized_amount * 1.0 / p.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY under_provisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, ROUND(ab.ledger_balance, 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ab.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY ab.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary AS asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector ind
    ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY debt_service_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    occupation_code,
    employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou
    ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON ah.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON (pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id)
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc
    ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ctc.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT td.account_id, td.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv
    ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
  ca.collateral_id,
  ca.asset_label,
  COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    so.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON so.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p
    ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    so.agreement_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
HAVING gc.guaranteed_amount > SUM(ld.disbursed_amount)
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.guarantor_party_id ASC,
    so.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY balance_multiple DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.recognized_amount - p.required_amount), 2) AS over_provision_amount
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON p.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = p.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND p.recognized_amount > p.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY over_provision_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC

WITH internal_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(ev.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal - ev.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM internal_val iv
JOIN external_val ev ON iv.collateral_id = ev.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = iv.collateral_id
WHERE ev.max_external < iv.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collateral_id ORDER BY valued_on DESC, valuation_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM collateral_valuation
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pledged AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, SUM(pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged, 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged - lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON lv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN pledged p ON p.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE p.total_pledged > lv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(borrow.borrow_amount, 0), 2) AS borrow_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guar.guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS guarantee_amount
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS borrow_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) borrow ON borrow.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guar ON guar.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE guar.guarantee_amount > borrow.borrow_amount
ORDER BY guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp
    ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  c.name_zh AS group_type_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i
  ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog c
  ON eg.group_type = c.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY
  i.institution_name,
  c.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
   AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_src
    ON ca_src.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_tgt
    ON ca_tgt.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(g.guaranteed_total, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(g.guaranteed_total - COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guaranteed_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS loan_total
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = g.party_id
WHERE g.guaranteed_total > COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT
  p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
  p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
  ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证金额,
  gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM loan_drawdown ld
  JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
  JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT agreement_id
        FROM credit_agreement
        WHERE borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
    )
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
  ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i
  ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
  ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
 AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CONNECTED_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
  wp.product_name,
  ma.asset_name,
  phs.lookthrough_depth,
  ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
  ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
  ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
  ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
      AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  )
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
  ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
 AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
  phs.holding_id,
  wp.product_name,
  ma.asset_name,
  phs.lookthrough_depth,
  phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY
  phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
  phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(f.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
       ROUND(f.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
       ROUND(f.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
       ROUND(f.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f
  ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
 AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY f.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
  ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
 AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
  ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
 AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
  ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'), 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i
  ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30') > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i
  ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC

SELECT
  i.institution_id,
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
  ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
  ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
  ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
 AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_grade_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg
  ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, risk_grade_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dd.loan_id) AS npl_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown dd
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON dd.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = dd.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
  ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
  ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, ld.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
  ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
  ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
  ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
  ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = pm.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pm.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pm.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        MAX(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.institution_id
),
inst_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(shortfall_amount), 2) AS total_shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_shortfall
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
submission_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
      AND (completion_date IS NULL OR completion_date > deadline_date)
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    so.overdue_record_count,
    so.avg_amount,
    COALESCE(isf.shortfall_loan_count, 0) AS shortfall_loan_count,
    COALESCE(isf.total_shortfall_amount, 0.00) AS total_shortfall_amount
FROM submission_overdue so
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = so.institution_id
LEFT JOIN inst_shortfall isf ON isf.institution_id = so.institution_id
WHERE so.overdue_record_count >= 25
ORDER BY total_shortfall_amount DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
  p.display_name AS customer_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_count
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p
  ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr
  ON pr.source_party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
  ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_count DESC, relation_type_count DESC, customer_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.exception_flag = 1 THEN o.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) AS op_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN account a
    ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 o
    ON o.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND o.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY op_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
  ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount END), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
  COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
  ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp
  ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce
  ON pce.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
  ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN coe.record_id END) AS active_custody_records,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN coe.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 coe ON coe.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
